thread:
support_jen: Heads-up — ACME case escalated. They rotated a service token and now users see a 403 in the web console for project 'acme-prod'. CLI calls to some API endpoints still succeed. Customer repro they sent:

> 1) Sign in to console -> Projects -> select acme-prod
> 2) UI shows 403 banner: "Permission denied"
> 3) CLI: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <svc-token>" https://api.redwood.dev/v1/projects/acme-prod -> 200 (project metadata)
> 4) CLI: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <svc-token>" https://api.redwood.dev/v1/console/session -> 403

Can someone check token binding / role propagation for Dedicated customers? They rotated via our onboarding script this morning.

alex: Do we have the exact console error and request id? Also which principal id did they rotate (friendly name or GUID)?

support_jen: Browser console shows: ERROR 403 PermissionDenied: principal "svc-acme-prod" missing permission "project.console.view" (req=req_9f8e7d6c). Customer confirms request id matches access logs. They used the friendly principal name in the UI.

samir: Sounds like a rotation created a new principal entry and the role-assignment job didn't attach project roles. Note: console session creation does an exchange that requires the principal to have the console.access permission in addition to API scopes. If delegated console scopes were dropped on rotation, the session exchange fails even though API calls to open endpoints work.

maya: I'll check bindings. Run locally: redwoodctl iam get-bindings --principal svc-acme-prod --project acme-prod --output=json. support_jen, did they give the principal as svc-acme-prod or svc-acme-prod@acme? rotation scripts sometimes use the tenant-qualified name.

alex: I ran the command against prod store: returned empty array []. No explicit bindings found for that principal on acme-prod. That explains missing console rights.

support_jen: Customer says the principal appeared on their Service Tokens page earlier. They didn't manually re-add roles. They used our rotation script from docs.

samir: Two immediate remediation paths: 1) Rebind roles to the new principal (fast). 2) Fix rotation pipeline and schedule a backfill for any customers impacted (requires infra deploy). For now let's rebind and inform customer. Command to run: redwoodctl iam add-binding --project acme-prod --principal "svc-acme-prod" --roles project.viewer,console.access --actor support-jen. The key is to include console.access.

maya: I'll do a dry-run first: redwoodctl iam add-binding --project acme-prod --principal svc-acme-prod --roles project.viewer,console.access --dry-run.

engbot: [automation] Job queued: job-2026-0801-901: redwoodctl iam add-binding --project acme-prod --principal svc-acme-prod --roles project.viewer,console.access --actor maya --dry-run

alex: Dry-run output: ok: would add binding role=project.viewer to principal=svc-acme-prod; ok: would add binding role=console.access to principal=svc-acme-prod

maya: Running live now (non-dry-run).

engbot: [automation] Job completed: job-2026-0801-901 success; audit_id=audit_b12c; effected_principal=svc-acme-prod

maya: Verified bindings: redwoodctl iam get-bindings --principal svc-acme-prod --project acme-prod -> ["project.viewer (granted_by=role-sync)", "console.access (granted_by=manual-support)"]

support_jen: Notified customer and asked them to hard refresh and retry. Case #24567.

customer_acme: Refreshing now... console access restored, thanks! :tada:

samir: Follow-ups: 1) Patch token-rotation to persist delegated console scopes so exchange doesn't break. 2) Add quick role-sync hook post rotation to reconcile bindings (within 5m). 3) Add alert when a principal exists in token store for a project but has zero bindings for that project. I'll open PR + SI.

maya: Created infra PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/PR/1853 to fix role propagation on rotation. Created SI ticket SI-7940 to backfill and track customers. ETA for deploy: EOD PT.

alex: Audit id audit_b12c created; we can share if customer requests trail. Also updating runbook with explicit note for Dedicated customers using custom principals.

support_jen: Closing case with ACME, adding internal postmortem notes to ticket. Thanks all. :white_check_mark: 

samir: Small ops note: if we see repeated failures, we should consider making the rotation process atomic (rotate principal metadata and reapply bindings in same transaction) to avoid transient access gaps. I'll add that to the PR description.

maya: Also updated runbook docs PR: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/PR/467 to mention rebind step for customers using onboarding scripts.

alex: 👍
